verdict.rationale: Ultrametric documents a package-manager install (`npm install -g ultrametric@0.4.1`). A second step, `ultrametric init` (after an optional `--dry-run` preview), then writes skill files into the project for Codex and Claude Code, and those files can be committed for the team. This is a two-step flow rather than the single command the story asks for. The docs never explicitly say the skills are active in the next agent session. Missing for 10: a true one-command install (or in-agent marketplace command), explicit documentation that the skills load automatically in the next session, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of the install flow.
